MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 14
   C. 33
   D. 28

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 24.5
   D. 49

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 30

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
